g.text: Front channel roof — verified Bambu toolpaths
45° bridge direction · no support · longest unsupported centerline span 14.48 mm
Blue: roof bridge extrusions at print Z 8.3 mm. Gray: frame section immediately below the roof.
Inspect the first printed roof for sagging or strings before threading wires. Keep the frame’s bridge-angle override when re-slicing.
View uses front coordinates; the actual part prints face-down. Actual bridge performance still depends on the PLA+ spool and cooling.
